plan.line: a vibration sensor module (SW-420): notices knocks, shaking and vibration of whatever it stands on (sensitivity set with its screw); its output changes for a moment with each shake. It can't measure how strong a vibration is.

code.pinLine: vibration sensor {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN). Its DO changes only for a moment on each shake or knock. Read the value at the start while still (idle = pin.value()) and count any other value as a vibration; read it very often (time.sleep_ms(1) or less) or catch the change with Pin.irq(trigger=Pin.IRQ_RISING | Pin.IRQ_FALLING), and ignore it for about 200 ms after each one.
handoff: | {gpio} | {phys} | {refs} | {mode} | `Pin({g}, Pin.IN)  (changes for a moment on a shake)` |
